Collapsible sections and centered content, as on GitHub. More at [www.malgel.com](https://www.malgel.com).

## New

- **`<details>` sections open and close.** A `<details>` with a `<summary>` shows only its summary until you click it; `<details open>` starts open. Markdown inside, between blank lines, renders as usual.
- **Centered and right-aligned content.** `align="center"` or `align="right"` on `<div>`, `<p>` and headings, `style="text-align: …"`, and `<center>` align what's inside. The logo, badges and title at the top of many READMEs now look as they do on GitHub.
- **Exports keep them.** HTML export keeps `<details>` and alignment, PDF and Word exports print sections open with their summary in bold, and images sized with `<img width="…">` keep that size.

## Fixed

- Images in GitHub alerts now load when their paths are relative to the document.

## Downloads

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Malgel-0.1.3-macos-universal.dmg`: open it and drag Malgel to Applications |
| Windows 10+ | `Malgel-0.1.3-windows-x64-setup.exe` (installer) or `Malgel-0.1.3-windows-x64.zip` (portable) |
| Linux x86_64 | `Malgel-0.1.3-x86_64.AppImage` (`chmod +x` it, then run it) or `malgel-0.1.3-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |

The macOS app is signed and notarized. The Windows files aren't signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn the first time: choose **More info → Run anyway**. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
